items.title: Reality-web listing generateMetadata can throw during SSR on malformed 200 body
evidence: app/[locale]/listings/[slug]/page.tsx:75 getListing returns response.json() typed as ListingDetail with no runtime validation; generateMetadata:93 calls listing.description.slice(0,160) and listing.address.city guarded only by the !listing null-check at :86, so a 200 body with null description / missing address from reality-server throws during SSR instead of degrading to the existing 'Listing Not Found' fallback

items.title: Announcer: untracked clear-then-set timeouts can resurrect a stale screen-reader message
evidence: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/components/Announcer.tsx:49,58 — the 'clear-then-set' announce timeouts (setTimeout(() => setPoliteMessage(message), 100) and the assertive equivalent) are not stored in politeTimeoutRef/assertiveTimeoutRef; only the 3000ms clear timeout is tracked
on a rapid second announce(), the prior pending set is never cancelled, so a stale message can be written after the new one; unmount cleanup clears only the 3000ms ref, not these pending sets
low-severity a11y bug — affects screen-reader announcements only; fix is to store and clear the set-timeouts alongside the existing clear-timeout refs
